assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: The square 0 <= b, c <= 5 in the (b, c)-plane with the dashed line c = 3 and the red parabola b^2 = 4c; the strip c > 3 is shaded light blue, and the part of it to the right of the parabola (real roots) is shaded orange.

difficulty_rationale: Part (a) needs only Vieta's formula for the product; part (b) adds the discriminant condition and a short integral for the area of the region.
